claims.disproof_condition: 威脅成立方向：任一 EV OEM 具名採用 HRE-free 磁石於牽引馬達（設計中標／量產聲明）→ 重稀土需求軸下修。威脅不成立方向：HRE-free 磁石在高溫矯頑力驗證失敗、僅停留樣品階段超過兩個財報週期、或僅用於非牽引應用 → 重稀土鏈維持。每季核對 Proterial 進展與 Lynas Dy/Tb 出貨量。
claims.statement: Proterial has heavy-rare-earth-free sintered NdFeB magnets at pre-production sample stage: NMX-F1SH-HF (Br = 1.40 T, HcJ ≥ 1671 kA/m, samples shipping) and NMX-G1NH-HF (Br = 1.42 T, HcJ ≥ 1830 kA/m, mass-production plant ready for pre-production samples April 2026), positioned for EV driving motors requiring high torque and heat resistance. If these qualify at EV OEMs and ramp, demand for separated heavy rare-earth oxides (Dy/Tb) in the largest magnet application weakens structurally — this is a standing disproof path for heavy-REO-bottleneck positioning (Lynas ex-China heavy REO axis, MP heavy separation build-out). Vendor self-report: performance numbers are Proterial's own; no EV OEM qualification win is named.

source_doc.title: Proterial Develops High-Performance Heavy-Rare-Earth-Free Neodymium Sintered Magnet for Electric Vehicle Driving Motors

sources.quote: NMX-G1NH-HF material is a heavy-rare-earth-free material that can be used even for driving motors requiring high torque and heat resistance.
The NMX-F1SH-HF material has magnetic properties with Br = 1.40 T and HcJ ≥ 1671 kA/m, permitting applications for driving motors as well as electric power steering and compressors.
Proterial's mass production plant has already started providing pre-production samples.
In April 2026, the mass-production plant will be ready to respond to requests for pre-production samples.
